1.During the quarter ended March 2026, Mr. Arvind Lature, belonging to the Promoter category, transferred his entire holding of 50,160 equity shares to Sarvatra Finance Private Limited. Consequently, Sarvatra Finance Private Limited has been included in the Promoter category in the shareholding pattern.
2. Mr. Somnath Gurushant Lature, falling under Promoter/ Promoter Group category, submitted an application for Reclassification from Promoter/ Promoter Group category to Public category under Reg 31(A) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The application was approved and No Objection letter is received from both stock exchanges on April 27, 2026. The reclassification was subsequently approved by the shareholders on June 20, 2026. Accordingly, his shareholding is reflected under the Public category in the shareholding pattern for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and thereafter.
